notes: Customer profile: mid-market SaaS (product analytics) building in-app AI assistant + search for product teams. Heavy embeddings usage for cross-doc search, chat for contextual help.
Initial intent: start on Hosted API for fast time-to-value, then move to Dedicated when usage stabilizes and unit economics favor reserved capacity.

POC highlights: batching + prefix caching reduced per-embedding token cost by ~37% in test workload; quantization (4-bit) reduced GPU hours but introduced minor accuracy drop on reranking tests (precision @10 down ~2-3%).
Performance targets: chat 95th pct latency <200ms, embeddings throughput target 100-150 TPS peak, reranking sub-second for top-10 queries.

Cost sensitivity: unit economics critical - CFO wants clear CPU/GPU burn breakdown and per-100k-queries cost scenarios before committing to Dedicated. Expecting ARR band ~75k-200k if Dedicated meets targets.
Security: must support SSO/SAML, customer-managed KMS for encryption-at-rest, audit logs retained for 1 year, EU data residency for EU customers.
Quote from product lead: "We liked the Hosted POC latency profile but need a deterministic billing model before we commit to reserved capacity."
Open questions: how Dedicated handles autoscaling for burst patterns, fallback policy to Hosted during maintenance, detailed quantization profiles supported per model.
Requested artifacts: Dedicated BOM + pricing worksheet, sample SLA for latency, walkthrough of Optimize recommendations (batch sizes, cache TTLs), security attestation for KMS/HSM integration.
